title: A Surfer Rode an 86-Foot Wave Off Portugal

scenes.text: A surfer rode a wave that was 86 feet tall.
That's about as tall as an eight-story building.
It happened on October 29th, 2020, at Nazare in Portugal, during Hurricane Epsilon.
The surfer was Sebastian Steudtner, and a jet ski towed him in.
He beat the old record by six feet. Officials measured it from video, frame by frame.
One mistake and he would have dropped from a seven-story height into the sea.

description:
A surfer rode a wave that was 86 feet tall.
Sebastian Steudtner did it at Nazare in Portugal on October 29, 2020, beating the previous record by six feet.
Would you ever try it?
